reference_observables.method: Ground-based optical and radar observations of the mutual orbit before and after impact.
Inference from the measured period change, system geometry, shape estimates and stated covariance assumptions.

conditioning.interpretation: Conditional estimate assuming Dimorphos and Didymos have equal bulk densities of 2400 kg/m^3.

sensitivity.interpretation: Published expected beta range across the stated Dimorphos bulk-density interval; this is not a universal material constant.

sources.title: Orbital period change of Dimorphos due to the DART kinetic impact
Momentum transfer from the DART mission kinetic impact on asteroid Dimorphos

not_established: This fixture does not reproduce DART impact hydrodynamics, crater formation or ejecta distribution.
The conditional beta estimate is not transferable to a different asteroid without characterization and validated physical modeling.
This historical reference case is not an operational impact-risk calculation, mission design or flight qualification.
Hera-derived mass and internal-structure constraints are not included in this baseline fixture.
